# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I’m really frustrated with the quality of two skateboards I just bought. I’d like to return them and have the refund go back to my credit card, please. Also, I need to return a smart watch and an e-reader I just bought. If the same e-reader is available online, I’d be happy to exchange for the same item, and if not, I’ll take the 32GB storage e-reader instead. My name is Mei Ahmed, and my zip code is 78705. I don’t remember the email on the order, unfortunately.

Thanks, Mei — I found your account.

I can help, but first I need the specific order(s) and item(s) involved before I can process returns or an exchange.

Your orders on file are:
- #W7553978
- #W3239882
- #W2598324

Please tell me which order contains:
- the 2 skateboards you want to return
- the smart watch you want to return
- the e-reader you want to return or exchange

If you’re not sure, I can look up the order details for you one order at a time.

Thanks. I’m not totally sure which order has which, unfortunately. Could you please look them up one at a time for me?

I know I want to return:
- the 2 skateboards for a refund to my credit card
- the smart watch
- the e-reader, unless you can exchange it for the same one online, and if not then I’d want the 32GB e-reader instead

Sorry, I just don’t remember which order each item was on.
